ns2:course.label: Mid East Societies & Cultures
ns2:course.description: Overview of the contemporary Middle East from social, political, and cultural perspectives. Explores how the internal dynamics together with the forces of globalization shape the societies of the Middle East today. Topics include social structure, political dynamics, family, gender, urban life Islam, social and religious movements. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: SOC 100 or six hours of Anthropology, Social Geography, Politics, or Sociology.
